summary: V2 features (Member DMs, community Rooms, Admin Dashboard) tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 new pytest cases PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_v2_features.py (members exclude self+admin, DM send/thread/unread/read/opt-out 403/empty 400/unknown 404, rooms list/post/invalid 404, admin overview/projects/polls, activation, and 403 for customers on admin routes). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): customer can open Messages from Community header, see a conversation + members list, open Bella's thread, send a DM which immediately appears; can open Rooms, tap General, send a room message which appears with sender bubble. Profile: customer does NOT see Admin row, admin DOES see it, Admin Dashboard renders all stat cards (Live activity + Community totals), lists 4 projects with owner name + email + redesign count, tapping a project opens detail modal with 'AI redesign generated' image, and clicking 'Set live' on a poll activates it (toast 'Poll activated for this week' shown, exclusivity preserved). issues: Non-blocking react-native-web deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' (use style.pointerEvents). Carried over from v1.

action_items: No blocking issues. V2 messaging + rooms + admin flows are all working. Consider optional polish: (1) suppress shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings; (2) admin dashboard shows Active projects 24h count but the timestamp comparison uses ISO string; already correct because updated_at is stored as ISO — noted only for future refactor.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~964 lines — approaching the 700 threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, projects, messaging, admin, ai) in a future refactor.
MessageCreate.text and RoomMessageCreate.text are unbounded strings; consider a max length (e.g., 2000 chars) for safety.
conversations() loads all user's DMs into memory to aggregate — fine at current scale but O(n) per request; consider a per-conversation collection or aggregation pipeline as message volume grows.
admin_overview counts total_designs by loading every project's designs array into memory — acceptable for now but scales poorly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (messaging, rooms, admin, regression)
